definition.instructions: Identify the service being offered or discussed, then map it to a sector. Do not map by payment instrument or requested action. If the sector is identifiable but unlisted, choose other; if it cannot be identified, choose unclear.

criteria.banking_finance: Banks, financial accounts, investing, insurance, or personal finance.
criteria.retail_ecommerce: Shopping, online orders, marketplaces, or consumer products.
criteria.shipping_logistics: Parcel delivery, postal services, freight, or courier tracking.
criteria.government_public_services: Government agencies, taxes, benefits, water, electricity, utilities, or public services.
criteria.technology_telecom: Software, online accounts, devices, internet, or phone services.
criteria.healthcare: Healthcare providers, pharmacies, medical services, or health insurance.
criteria.employment: Jobs, recruiting, payroll, or workplace services.
criteria.other: A recognizable industry that does not fit the listed categories.
criteria.unclear: There is not enough information to identify an industry.
